headlines.text: 2021 brought us this moment: KENTA announced their arrival in style, headlining their very first AEW appearance in a Falls Count Anywhere match, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.02 ? an excellent showing. AEW's first-ever televised crossover with New Japan ? a wild, chaotic Falls Count Anywhere brawl that spilled into the kitchen and backstage areas, later called one of the best Dynamite matches in a very long time.
On a Saturday in 2024, back when Esfinge made their AEW debut against Castagnoli & Moxley & Star, appearing on Collision, rated 6.42.
It was 2023 when The Butcher made their return to AEW television after 7 weeks away, appearing on Rampage.

secondaries.text: Turning the clock back to 2024: Orange Cassidy vs. Tomohiro Ishii headlined Collision, rated 7.50 ? a good, competitive contest.
It was 2021 when Cezar Bononi kicked off their AEW journey, appearing on Dynamite, rated 4.44.

2021 brought us this moment: Darby Allin vs. Joey Janela went to battle over the AEW TNT Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.09 ? a solid showing. Joey Janela was challenging for gold for the very first time.
